risks.risk: Folding hinge or frame may be cracked, loose or poorly welded, common on unbranded fat tyre folders.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the folding hinge and its latch, plus a clip folding and locking the frame.
risks.if_unproven: As a non-folding bike with a hinge needing repair.

risks.risk: Gears may not shift or brakes may not grip.
risks.proof: Clip riding the bike through every gear and braking hard with each lever.
risks.if_unproven: As needing a gear and brake service.

risks.risk: Accessories claimed may not be included.
risks.proof: One photo of every included accessory laid out beside the bike.
risks.if_unproven: Accessories given no value beyond the mudguards seen.

risks.risk: Photo may be a dealer stock image, not the actual unit, and wheel size is not stated.
risks.proof: Fresh photo of the bike beside a handwritten note with today's date, plus a close-up of the tyre size on the sidewall.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as the cheapest size of this type.

proof_requests: Fresh photo of the bike beside a handwritten note with today's date.
Close-up of the tyre sidewall showing the size, and of the frame for any brand or model.
Close-up photos of the folding hinge and latch.
Clip riding through the gears and braking.

response.reason: The photo clearly shows a fat tyre full suspension folding mountain bike, which can be priced by type at its worst case; the claimed accessories are unproven and are not paid for.
